name: Nani mo Shiranai. ~S-Ken S-Shi Shoujo Yuukai Kankin Jiken~
original_name: 何も知らない。～S県S市少女誘拐監禁事件～
source:
The murder of a mother and the kidnapping of a girl in S City, S Prefecture.
This case came to light on October 2, 1999.
I was the victim, but I know nothing about it.
Yeah, I don’t know a thing.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ01100307.html/]dlsite[/url]]
